notes.title: v2.0.1 Major Update Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[v2.0.1 Major Update Schedule Information]
Scheduled Release Date: [strike]2/28[/strike]  [strike]3/7[/strike] 3/14

Here’s what’s new:[olist]
 Introduction of the transmission function.
 Added multi-setting functionality for transmission cameras.
 New transmission tutorial included.
 Adjustments to font and icon sizes.
 Implementation of the login feature.
 Improved image quality for the Media Plan.
[/olist]
Stay tuned for the update!

notes.content:

notes.title: XROOM Steam v1.2.5 Upload
notes.content:
Update

 Added functionality to reorder PPT slots.
 Added adjustable properties for PPT objects.
 Copy and paste functionality for TransformAttribute.
 Redesigned the TransformAttribute modal UI.
 Updated camera TransformAttribute modification options.
 Added a scale lock feature.
 Ensured resolution consistency for media sources in MediaPlayer.
 Modal UI now closes on ESC key input.
 Improved GroupingObject functionality.
 Added the ability to reorder items in the Outliner.
 Modified the Outliner UI to display only selected items.


Bug Fixes
Fixed issues with drawing lines for decals and lights.
Resolved issues with applying lights placed in the map.
Adjusted the behavior of the scale gizmo for better control.
